q1_sensible_questions.note: Asking about yogurt is useful when availability affects a candidate recipe. The empty-retrieval question is too generic: prefer a concrete choice (e.g. accepting a similar dessert) without pretending a suitable alternative has already been found.

q2_stops_appropriately.note: The demonstrated limit stops are reasonable. Some sufficient-evidence stops are premature because grounding and skip checks are incomplete (findings P3-A-01, P3-A-02). Recovery messages must stay clear about retrying the current session versus starting another.

q3_preserves_answers.note: For the demonstrated yogurt answer and vegetarian-constraint cases. Verify with the real provider and resumed sessions; constraint persistence alone does not prove every proposed recipe satisfies it.

q4_adaptation_presented_as_source.note: Not in the displayed adaptation wording, but the broader source-grounding check is incomplete (P3-A-01). Keep the unverified-substitution label; a label does not validate substitution feasibility.

answers.additional_observation: The packet offers lentil soup for a chicken request without explaining why it is an alternative. Successful loop termination does not establish that the request was fulfilled; flag relevance in the live review.

findings.summary: Options can cite recipes that were never retrieved in the session.
findings.evidence: hard-constraint-conflict and epicure-skip make no tool calls, yet final options cite lentil-2 / curry-1; validate_options checks database existence and quantity match only.
findings.resolution_plan: Require each option's (dataset_id, source_id) to come from a successful search_recipes/get_recipe result in the same session (resumed turns included), with evidence sufficient for the quantities claimed.

findings.summary: Epicure skip policy contradicts the product policy and skip reasons are not checked for fit.
findings.evidence: ai-learning-plan.md line 42: 'Query and evaluate Epicure by default, including for specific dish requests.' The loop allows a direct_recipe_lookup skip and couples single-option answers to it (agent/validate.py:133, agent/loop.py:1476). 'Vegetarian dinner, something hearty' was accepted as direct_recipe_lookup; 'boil an egg, and what soup goes with it?' as simple_technique_question.
findings.resolution_plan: Remove the direct_recipe_lookup exemption, decouple single-option answers from skipping (keep only_one_valid_candidate), add a narrow pairing-cue guard for simple_technique_question, treat epicure_not_configured as a checked degraded mode, and measure skip quality in Phase 7.

live_evaluation.budget_condition: Enforced with pre-call spending reservations covering model turns, query embeddings and retries in one run-level ledger; stop before a call that cannot fit.
live_evaluation.database: Option A (application database) only with verified trial isolation; otherwise option B (explicitly identified disposable database).
live_evaluation.timing: After the P3-A-01/P3-A-02 fixes, before Phase 5.
live_evaluation.note: The paid run waits for the owner's explicit 'run it'.
